subject: Priority: ClearPass production impact — RCA deliverable & action tracker
messages:
From: ClearPass Support <support@clearpass.co>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:34:12 -0800
Subject: [Urgent] Production errors and elevated latency observed — ClearPass

Hi Laura / Monica —

We observed an elevated 5xx error rate and token-level latency spikes between 09:12–09:48 PT across our integration with model redwood-serve-v2. Customers report slow responses and occasional failures on their checkout flow. Attached are logs and a short timeline.

Immediate ask: can Redwood confirm whether this was a model serving degradation or infra-side throttling? This is affecting orders in our US region.

Thanks,
Aisha Markham
Sr. Platform Engineer — ClearPass Logistics

Attachments: clearpass-logs-20261117.tar.gz (log stub), timeline.txt

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Markham <aisha.markham@clearpass.co>, Marco Rossi <m.rossi@clearpass.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:02:01 -0800
Subject: Re: [Urgent] Production errors and elevated latency observed — ClearPass

Hi Aisha / Marco —

First, I'm sorry for the impact. I pulled our SLO dashboard and internal alerts; we saw a throughput regression concurrent with a spike in cache-miss rates that routed more work to slower quantized paths. We're treating this as a P2 incident and have engineering and infra looking at mitigations.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- Engineering will snapshot the serving config and collect full KV cache metrics (owner: Vivek).
- We'll prepare an initial incident timeline and plan a technical readout within 48 hours.
- I'll loop in Ben and Grace to discuss credits/contract impacts and exec-level communications.

Monica — can you triage the support ticket and consolidate customer impact details (order ids, timestamps)?

I'll follow up with a clearer timeline and an RCA as soon as available.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:27:45 -0800
Subject: Re: [Urgent] Production errors and elevated latency observed — ClearPass

Team —

Quick postmortem notes while we collect artifacts:
- Root cause (preliminary): an adaptive batch-splitting heuristic was triggered by an atypical spike in short-chunk requests. That caused suboptimal kernel selection and increased per-token latency; simultaneously a recent KV cache eviction policy change increased cache misses for a high-weight prefix.
- Impact window: 2026-11-17T16:12:00Z — 2026-11-17T16:48:00Z (US-West).
- Customer visible: 5–8% elevated 5xx rate, median token latency +240ms for affected flows, throughput reduced by ~18% for the checkouts route.

Planned mitigations (short term):
1) Roll back last cache policy change for affected pools (ETA 1h).
2) Apply a conservative batch-splitting guardrail and revert heuristic update (ETA 2h).
3) Expand monitoring alerts to capture this specific short-request distribution.

I'll attach the engineering artifacts once collected. Ready to present technical readout.

Vivek
Director, Serving Runtime

Attachments: (will attach serving-metrics-17nov.csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Markham <aisha.markham@clearpass.co>, Marco Rossi <m.rossi@clearpass.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:15:09 -0800
Subject: Interim technical readout + next steps (ClearPass impact)

Hi Aisha / Marco —

Thanks for filing the ticket and for your patience. Summary of what we know so far:
- We identified a runtime spike caused by batch-splitting + KV cache miss coupling. Engineering rolled back the cache policy within an hour and applied a temporary heuristic guard. That resolved the majority of errors and normalized latency by ~15:30 PT.
- We're producing a formal RCA and an action tracker; draft attached ("20261122-clearpass-rca.pdf").

Customer-facing asks:
- Can you confirm whether the window 09:12–09:48 PT maps to the orders you saw? Monica, please share the consolidated order ids.

Commercial/Exec note: Ben / Grace — ClearPass will ask about credits and remediation. We should propose a goodwill credit and share a remediation timeline.

Proposed timeline to ClearPass:
- Today: share RCA draft and mitigation summary.
- 48 hours: deliver final RCA + corrected SLO report and long-term mitigation plan.
- 2 weeks: deploy and validate cache policy improvements and new guardrails.

I'll set a readout meeting for Friday and propose the credit language in a follow-up.

Best,
Laura

Attachments: 20261122-clearpass-rca.pdf (draft), slo-impact-summary.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:43:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Interim technical readout + next steps (ClearPass impact)

Laura / team —

I reviewed the draft RCA and the impact numbers. Suggested commercial response: 1) a one-time service credit equivalent to 5% of November usage for ClearPass (to be approved by finance), 2) an offer for a technical whiteboard session with ClearPass engineering to walk through the long-term mitigations.

Grace — can you draft two options for the credit wording (soft vs explicit SLA credit) and any required contract notes? We'll need a single POC at ClearPass to sign off.

Also: start tracking owner/resolution dates in the action tracker; we should capture owners and acceptance criteria for each mitigation item. Monica, please add the customer order ids into the tracker once you have them.

Ben
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Markham <aisha.markham@clearpass.co>, Marco Rossi <m.rossi@clearpass.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 15:12:03 -0800
Subject: Final RCA deliverable + action tracker (ClearPass)

Aisha / Marco —

Attached is the finalized RCA and the action tracker: 20261122-clearpass-rca.pdf, clearpass-action-tracker.csv. Highlights:
- Root cause: interaction between recent cache eviction policy change and batch-splitting heuristic for short requests; regression was introduced during the 2026-11-10 performance rollout.
- Customer impact: elevated 5xx rate (peak 8%), median token latency +240ms for affected route, throughput down ~18% for the checkout path during the thirty-six minute window.
- Remediations completed: cache policy rollback (11/17 09:46 PT), heuristic guard applied (11/17 10:05 PT), improved alerts deployed (11/18).
- Open action items (tracking owner / ETA):
  - Formalize conservative batch-splitting default and ship config flag (owner: Vivek; ETA: 2026-11-29)
  - Add regression unit to nightly performance tests for short-request skew (owner: Grace; ETA: 2026-11-25)
  - Commercial credit proposals (owner: Ben; ETA: 2026-11-23)
  - Post-deploy validation run and metrics report (owner: Monica; ETA: 2026-12-01)

Ben — we propose the 5% goodwill credit reflected in the attached options. Please confirm and we'll move to a finance approval path.

Aisha / Marco — please confirm receipt and whether you want a technical whiteboard this week or next. We're committed to preventing recurrence and will share follow-up status updates on the tracker link.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261122-clearpass-rca.pdf, clearpass-action-tracker.csv
